Step-by-Step Journeys

Curated Itinerary Timelines

Tested routes with insider timing recommendations, activity highlights, and verified host connections.

7 Days • Moderate PaceIdeal for: Couples, Culture Seekers, First-time Visitors

7-Day Imperial Marrakech & Sahara Dunes Explorer

From vibrant medina courtyards across the snow-capped High Atlas to the silence of Erg Chebbi

Interactive Route:

Timeline Steps (Click Day to Preview)

Day 01 — Marrakech Medina~6 hrs
Arrival in Marrakech & Medina Sunset

Settle into your boutique riad, enjoy a traditional mint tea welcome, and explore the evening buzz of Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

Day 02 — Marrakech Old Town~8 hrs
Palaces, Secret Gardens & Culinary Masters

Discover Bahia Palace zellige, wander Jardin Majorelle, and cook your own slow-simmered lamb tagine.

Day 03 — Tizi n'Tichka & Ouarzazate~9 hrs
High Atlas Pass & Kasbah Ait Benhaddou

Cross the dramatic 2,260m Tizi n'Tichka mountain pass into the ancient mud-brick UNESCO fortress of Ait Benhaddou.

Day 04 — Todra Gorge & Merzouga Dunes~8 hrs
Todra Gorge to Merzouga Golden Dunes

Walk beneath 300m limestone canyon walls at Todra Gorge before arriving at the edge of the golden Sahara dunes.

Day 05 — Erg Chebbi Dunes~7 hrs
Sahara Sunrise, Sandboarding & Berber Culture

Watch the sun rise over endless sand dunes, try sandboarding down giant slopes, and visit local Khamlia musicians.

Day 1 FocusMarrakech Medina

Arrival in Marrakech & Medina Sunset

Settle into your boutique riad, enjoy a traditional mint tea welcome, and explore the evening buzz of Jemaa el-Fnaa square.
